cases.name: plain
cases.why: The ordinary mechanism, and the repository's third hand-authored byte assertion.

cases.name: empty_mechanism
cases.why: A legacy empty string is a zero length prefix followed by nothing, which must not be confused with the -1 null prefix.

cases.name: unicode_mechanism
cases.why: A 10-character, 20-byte mechanism: the legacy int16 prefix counts bytes.

cases.name: mechanism_longer_than_a_single_byte_length
cases.why: A 300-byte mechanism needs both bytes of the int16 prefix (0x01 0x2c); a single-byte length would truncate it.

cases.name: synthesized_populated_v0
cases.why: Every field this version declares, present and non-default: one element in every array, every nullable thing supplied. The defaults case leaves arrays empty, which hides every field of the struct the array would have held — a records field encoded with the wrong length prefix survived the whole corpus that way, because nothing ever reached the struct holding it.
